newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley CFO to head fund company - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley CFO to head fund company - NYT.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Chief Financial Officer Philip Duff has been tapped to be chief executive and president of Van Kampen American Capital, the Midwest mutual fund company acquired by Morgan last fall, The New York Times reported on Friday.
The newspaper attributed the story to company executives.
Appointing one of its top executives to Van Kampen would highlight Morgan's strategy of expanding beyond its traditional capital markets franchise, the newspaper said.
Morgan wants to sell mutual funds and other investments to small investors even as it advises its traditional institutional clients, the newspaper said.
